subject: Executive recap: private hosting discussion - open asks & next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Executive recap: Private hosting discussion - summary & open asks

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side to make sure we captured priorities and to surface the concrete asks we agreed on. I tried to keep this tight for your execs.

High-level goals you shared:
- Move sensitive PII inference into a private hosting model (VPC or on-prem) to meet your compliance roadmap.
- Minimize egress of any telemetry/PII outside Novacare-controlled networks.
- Keep inference latency below ~200ms for core flows, target scale ~2k concurrent users (bursty).

Primary pain points / constraints we heard:
- Regulatory driver: certain workflows require air-gap-like isolation for EU-facing workloads.
- Networking: no direct outbound to the public internet from the inference subnet; customer-managed NAT/bastion preferred with strict allowlist.
- Ops: procurement requires a list of required ports/IPs and a clear SOW before security sign-off.
- Data handling: no persistent logs outside your VPC and KMS/HSM key ownership for encryption at rest.

Concrete asks we agreed to action (next 7 business days):
1) Redwood: deliver a one-page architecture diagram for a Private deployment (on-prem + VPC variants) showing egress, peering, and HSM touchpoints — due 2027-06-09. (attachment: redwood-private-deploy-proposed-actions.pdf)
2) Novacare: confirm procurement lead and timing; provide contact for security reviewer and any required attestation templates.
3) Novacare: provide IP allowlist windows / firewall policy or confirm if private peering is preferred to NAT.
4) Redwood: pre-fill SOC2/ISO attestation package + a short checklist mapping to your controls — we will share a link.

Proposed immediate next step: a technical deep-dive with Karthik (our infra lead) + your networking/security reviewer to validate the allowlist and peering approach. Suggested slots: 2027-06-10 09:00-10:00 PT or 2027-06-11 14:00-15:00 PT.

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-proposed-actions.pdf (action plan stub), sequence-of-asks.csv (handy checklist)

If this looks right, I’ll schedule the deep-dive for the preferred slot and loop in Karthik and our solutions engineer.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
From: Elena Rivera <elena@novacare.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Ng <tom.ng@novacare.com>, procurement@novacare.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive recap: Private hosting discussion - summary & open asks

Markus —

Appreciate the crisp recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Procurement lead is procurement@novacare.com (Sara Ortiz is the PM). Procurement timeline: they want vendor packaging and SOW by 2027-06-20 for Q3 kickoff.
- Security reviewer: Tom Ng (cc’d). He’ll need the attestation package and a list of any telemetry/data flows that touch Redwood-managed services.
- On the isolation requirement: for the highest-risk PII flows we do intend to enforce a form of air-gap — that likely means an on-prem or fully private VPC with no internet egress and strict HSM control.
- Logging: we cannot allow persistent inference logs to leave our VPC. Transient logs for debugging are OK if they are stored short-term and purged; we need a retention policy in the SOW.

I attached a short requirements doc that summarizes our compliance constraints (Novacare_requirements.pdf).

We can do the deep-dive on 2027-06-11 14:00 PT — Tom will attend and bring network details. Please include Karthik and Ben from your side.

Thanks,
Elena Rivera
VP Product, Novacare Health
elena@novacare.com

Elena —

Quick notes on what we’ll bring to the deep-dive:
- Karthik will walk through an architecture diagram for both VPC peering and on-prem deployment, including required ports/IPs and the HSM integration pattern.
- We’ll provide the SOC2/ISO attestation bundle and a redlineable SOW draft prior to the call (expect link by EOD 2027-06-09).
- Action ownership: Redwood will own the architecture diagram and SOW draft; Novacare to provide allowlist / peering preference and procurement onboarding info.

HubSpot / logistics: RDW deal RDW-2027-0198 — I’ve added the proposed next steps to the deal record (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890). Please review and add any procurement notes.

We’ll also include a short technical appendix in the Drive link so Tom can forward to his compliance team quickly: https://drive.redwood.com/privatedeploy/rdw-2027-0198/action-plan

Best,
Markus
